items.source: Spring-AI Bedrock spring.ai.bedrock.aws.profile.name, If spring.ai.bedrock.aws.profile.credentials-path and spring.ai.bedrock.aws.profile.configuration-path are not specified, Spring AI use the standard AWS shared files: ~/.aws/credentials for credentials and ~/.aws/config for configuration.
items.translation: Spring-AI Bedrock spring.ai.bedrock.aws.profile.name，如果未指定 spring.ai.bedrock.aws.profile.credentials-path 和 spring.ai.bedrock.aws.profile.configuration-path，Spring AI 将使用标准的 AWS 共享文件：用于凭据的 ~/.aws/credentials 和用于配置的 ~/.aws/config。

items.source: Spring AI supports the Embedding AI models available through Amazon Bedrock by implementing the Spring EmbeddingModel interface.
items.translation: Spring AI 通过实现 Spring EmbeddingModel 接口，支持通过 Amazon Bedrock 提供的 Embedding AI 模型。

items.source: Enable the Models to use: Go to Amazon Bedrock and from the Model Access menu on the left, configure access to the models you are going to use.
items.translation: 启用模型使用：前往 Amazon Bedrock，并在左侧的 Model Access 菜单中配置您将要使用的模型的访问权限。

items.source: Spring-AI Bedrock spring.ai.bedrock.aws.access-key and spring.ai.bedrock.aws.secret-key properties.
items.translation: Spring-AI Bedrock 的 spring.ai.bedrock.aws.access-key 和 spring.ai.bedrock.aws.secret-key 属性。

items.source: Java System Properties - aws.accessKeyId and aws.secretAccessKey.
items.translation: Java 系统属性 - aws.accessKeyId 和 aws.secretAccessKey。

items.source: Environment Variables - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
items.translation: 环境变量 - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID 和 AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY。

items.source: Instance profile credentials delivered through the Amazon EC2 metadata service or set the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables.
items.translation: 通过 Amazon EC2 元数据服务提供的实例配置文件凭证，或设置 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID 和 AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY 环境变量。

items.source: In addition to the standard Spring-AI Bedrock credentials and region properties configuration, Spring-AI provides support for custom AwsCredentialsProvider and AwsRegionProvider beans.
items.translation: 除了标准的 Spring-AI Bedrock 凭证和区域属性配置外，Spring-AI 还支持自定义的 AwsCredentialsProvider 和 AwsRegionProvider 豆（beans）。

items.source: Spring AI Bedrock Cohere Embeddings: spring.ai.model.embedding=bedrock-cohere
items.translation: Spring AI Bedrock Cohere Embeddings：spring.ai.model.embedding=bedrock-cohere

items.source: Spring AI Bedrock Titan Embeddings: spring.ai.model.embedding=bedrock-titan
items.translation: Spring AI Bedrock Titan Embeddings：spring.ai.model.embedding=bedrock-titan

items.source: Following the Bedrock recommendations, Spring AI transitioned to using Amazon Bedrock’s Converse API for all Chat conversation implementations in Spring AI. The Bedrock Converse API has the following key benefits:
items.translation: 遵循 Bedrock 的建议，Spring AI 已将所有 Chat 对话实现切换为使用 Amazon Bedrock 的 Converse API。 Bedrock Converse API 具有以下核心优势：

items.source: The Converse API does not support embedding operations, so these will remain in the current API and the embedding model functionality in the existing InvokeModel API will be maintained
items.translation: Converse API 不支持嵌入（embedding）操作，因此这些操作将保留在当前 API 中，且现有 InvokeModel API 中的嵌入模型功能将继续保留。

items.source: Amazon Bedrock is a managed service that provides foundation models from various AI providers, available through a unified API.
items.translation: Amazon Bedrock 是一项托管服务，提供来自各种 AI 提供商的基础模型，并可通过统一的 API 进行访问。

items.source: Obtain AWS credentials: If you don’t have an AWS account and AWS CLI configured yet, this video guide can help you configure it: AWS CLI & SDK Setup in Less Than 4 Minutes!. You should be able to obtain your access and security keys.
items.translation: 获取 AWS 凭证：如果您还没有 AWS 账号且尚未配置 AWS CLI，此视频指南可以帮助您进行配置：AWS CLI & SDK Setup in Less Than 4 Minutes!。您应当能够获取您的访问密钥（access key）和安全密钥（security key）。

items.source: Then add the Spring Boot Starter dependency to your project’s Maven pom.xml build file:
items.translation: 然后将 Spring Boot Starter 依赖添加到您项目的 Maven pom.xml 构建文件中：

items.source: or to your Gradle build.gradle build file.
items.translation: 或者添加到您的 Gradle build.gradle 构建文件中。

items.source: Use the BedrockAwsConnectionProperties to configure AWS credentials and region:
items.translation: 使用 <code >BedrockAwsConnectionProperties< /code > 来配置 AWS 凭证和区域：

items.source: The region property is compulsory.
items.translation: region 属性是必填的。

items.source: Credentials delivered through the Amazon EC2 container service if the AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI environment variable is set and the security manager has permission to access the variable.
items.translation: 如果设置了 AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI 环境变量且安全管理器拥有访问该变量的权限，则凭证将通过 Amazon EC2 容器服务传递。

items.source: Spring-AI Bedrock spring.ai.bedrock.aws.region property.
items.translation: Spring-AI Bedrock spring.ai.bedrock.aws.region 属性。

items.source: Java System Properties - aws.region.
items.translation: Java 系统属性 - aws.region。

items.source: Environment Variables - AWS_REGION.
items.translation: 环境变量 - AWS_REGION。

items.source: For example, to enable the Bedrock Cohere embedding model, you need to set spring.ai.model.embedding=bedrock-cohere.
items.translation: 例如，若要启用 Bedrock Cohere 嵌入模型，您需要设置 spring.ai.model.embedding=bedrock-cohere。

items.source: Next, you can use the spring.ai.bedrock.<model>.embedding.* properties to configure each model as provided.
items.translation: 接下来，您可以使用 spring.ai.bedrock.<model>.embedding.* 属性来配置提供的每个模型。

items.source: Unified Interface: Write your code once and use it with any supported Amazon Bedrock model
items.translation: 统一接口：编写一次代码，即可用于任何支持的 Amazon Bedrock 模型

items.source: Model Flexibility: Seamlessly switch between different conversation models without code changes
items.translation: 模型灵活性：无需更改代码即可在不同的对话模型之间无缝切换

items.source: Extended Functionality: Support for model-specific parameters through dedicated structures
items.translation: 扩展功能：通过专用结构支持模型特定参数

items.source: Tool Support: Native integration with function calling and tool usage capabilities
items.translation: 工具支持：原生集成函数调用和工具使用能力

items.source: Multimodal Capabilities: Built-in support for vision and other multimodal features
items.translation: 多模态能力：内置对视觉及其他多模态功能的支持

items.source: Future-Proof: Aligned with Amazon Bedrock’s recommended best practices
items.translation: 面向未来：符合 Amazon Bedrock 推荐的最佳实践

items.source: Additionally, Spring AI provides Spring Auto-Configurations and Boot Starters for all clients, making it easy to bootstrap and configure for the Bedrock models.
items.translation: 此外，Spring AI 为所有客户端提供了 Spring Auto-Configurations 和 Boot Starters，使得为 Bedrock 模型进行引导和配置变得非常简单。
